entities.name: Query Nnr-like protein
observations: 623 aa; predicted molecular mass 64.2 kDa and acidic theoretical pI 4.41.
Contains a YjeF_N domain at residues 37–237 and two Carb_kinase-family regions at residues 293–442 and 493–583.
Sequence similarity to curated Mycobacterium tuberculosis Nnr proteins is 33.5% identity over 85.4% query coverage, E-value 6.61e-47.
Most likely a bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme, but exact substrate specificity remains inferred from homology.
Likely soluble enzyme; no transmembrane segment or secretion signal was reported.

entities.name: Nnr
observations: Curated homologs P9WF10, P9WF11, and P37391 are bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes.
Catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H, producing AMP and phosphate.
Curated annotations assign EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136 and a potassium ion cofactor.
Associated with metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
